newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU estimates 1997 grain output around 200 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: EU estimates 1997 grain output around 200 mln tns.

text.p: EU grain production is expected to total around 200 million tonnes in 1997 against 201.5 million last year, according to European Commission estimates.
The estimates, presented last week to the EU cereals advisory committee, were based on a 1.6 percent increase in the 1997 cereals area to 37.5 million hectares and was allocated as follows
Coceral last week estimated a 2.7 percent increase to 37.4 million ha in cereals plantings. It saw output falling to 197.3 million tonnes, from 201.5 million in 1996.
COPA, the EU farmers' lobby, forecast a 3.1 percent increase in plantings to 38.03 million ha. But it saw production falling to 199.45 million tonnes from 205.81 million in 1996.
The European Commission put EU cereals consumption at around 171-172 million tonnes in 1996/97, similar to Coceral's figure of 172.6 million.

In minutes of the advisory committee meeting, Coceral said the Commission estimated 1996/97 grain exports at 29 million tonnes, imports 4.8 million tonnes and offers into intervention stores at between 2.3 and 2.4 million tonnes.
Soft wheat exports were estimated at 10 million tonnes, with flour exports put at 5.8 million tonnes in wheat equivalent. --Brussels bureau +322 287 6830
